summary: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics…
description:
WHO WE ARE
Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO
Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning…

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

description:
Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse
Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands.
Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations.
You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development.
The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.
Everything you build is open source and immediately visible.
All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels.

What You’ll Do
Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own…

description:
Why Design at Langfuse

Your work will shape how engineers build with AI.
Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible.
The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. Traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with massive prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage prompt versions, configure integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy.
You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

You will grow at Langfuse by
Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. Today, our engineers design as they build, which has gotten us far, but we need someone who can elevate the entire experience. You'll own the design system, and visual language across the product. description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

 The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second, integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB, and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes, with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane — the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. Our platform consists of two core components: a capacity reservation engine managing guaranteed GPU reservations and their lifecycle, including rebalancing and auto-reclamation logic; and a Quotas Control Plane that manages quotas across all Nebius services, handles customer quota requests, and runs the algorithms that distribute resources. L'équipe Field Marketing & B2B Events crée des événements pour les professionnels de santé : congrès, événements propres et activations locales. Ils renforcent notre marque et soutiennent directement les équipes Sales. En rejoignant l'équipe, vous devenez le pilier opérationnel qui rend ces événements possibles : vous fiabilisez les inscriptions, la facturation et la logistique, et vous libérez du temps pour que l'équipe se concentre sur ce qui crée le plus de valeur. Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :
Piloter les inscriptions aux événements : suivre les listes, relancer, mettre à jour les données et assurer le lien avec les équipes Sales.

Gérer les commandes de goodies et de supports : demandes de devis, commandes, suivi des livraisons et des stocks.

Structurer et fiabiliser nos process et nos documents : archivage, templates, tableaux de suivi, automatisation simple de tâches répétitives.

Contribuer à l'événementiel : soutenir l'équipe sur site, participer aux événements et aider au suivi des résultats

Formation aux produits : assurer la formation des professionnels de santé à nos solutions au sein de leur cabinet

Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

What you'll do

We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems.

Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted.

In this role, you will:
Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib

description:
Who are we?
The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.
Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.
We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.
Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months
Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

Sign our first contracts.

FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards.

This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world.

Video understanding with VLMs: action recognition, temporal grounding and long-video reasoning on factory footage

Making models robust in the real world: occlusions, unusual viewpoints, new stations and products with little labelled data

Publishing at top venues (CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR) together with our ML team

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a closely related field, with a focus on computer vision or multimodal learning (finished or finishing by early-2027)

description:
As a Sales Excellence Manager (m/w/d), you will find where our sales funnel leaks and where we engage customers too slowly, then work with the sales teams until it is fixed across our global markets. You will own revenue per worked hour as our core productivity KPI, run capacity planning and bonus governance, and set the build priorities that turn your findings into tools. Analysis is your starting point, not your deliverable: you are measured on whether conversion, speed to lead and productivity actually move in each market.
PERGOLUX designs and sells premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from aluminium pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees and 9-figure revenue, we have grown consistently across markets in Europe, Australia, North America and Latin America, and our Sales Operations team keeps that engine running.
What You'll Do
- Analyse the funnel from lead to order by market, tier, channel and rep, find the stages where we lose the most revenue, and drive concrete fixes with each Sales Lead until the numbers move.
- Set and maintain response standards for every inbound channel (phone, web forms, chat, WhatsApp, MQLs), track speed to lead and draft order follow-up weekly, and escalate breaches with Sales Leads and our Tier 1 partner.
- Own revenue per worked hour as our core productivity KPI, from the definition with the Data team through baseline, targets and monthly reporting by market and tier.

PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets.

description:
We’re looking for a UI designer who loves casual games. You know what makes a game feel intuitive and fun to play, and you can turn that into clean, good-looking UI. You’ll be assisting the SOHO Art team and reporting directly to our Game Art Lead.
Heads up: we’ll ask you to do a short graphics assignment as part of the process.
What you’ll be doing:
Creating UI assets  - designing visually appealing interfaces that align with the game’s art direction. 

Matching our style - we have a very specific look. You’ll study it and create new elements that feel like part of the same family, so everything fits right in next to what we already have.

Using AI tools - speeding up your work with AI: quick ideas, variations, and rough explorations. Then you polish the final assets by hand until they meet our quality bar. 

Helping out with general art - characters, backgrounds, props, and other 2D assets when needed.

Taking feedback and running with it - we iterate a lot, and quick, smooth revisions make everyone’s life easier.

Owning your work- you decide how to scope it, prioritise it, and deliver it, without needing someone to hold your hand. 

What we’re looking for:
Experience working on casual games.

Strong UI design and execution skills, with good UX instincts.

Excellent 2D art skills.

Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality UI art for mobile titles from concept to final in-game execution.

About Alta Ares

Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

KIDAN est une entreprise de conseil IT en forte croissance, à taille humaine et à dimension internationale, dont le siège est en Suisse. description:

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

The role

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design…

Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.

Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.

User Policy Operations evaluates businesses against Stripe’s Terms of Service and related policies. We help Stripe support businesses responsibly while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader Stripe ecosystem.

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.
You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.
Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.
How it works
Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements
2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one…

Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About the team

The Incident Ops team is a global 24/7 team responsible for driving incident response and management from detection to resolution. Stripe is proud of its five 9s reliability and this team is at the forefront of ensuring we keep it that way - working hand-in-hand with Reliability Eng and across the Tech Org. This team of incident response managers (IRM) is defined by our sense of ownership and how we drive incidents to resolution - marshaling the necessary cross-functional resources to respond to and resolve service outages, critical bugs, security attacks and anything that significantly impacts the users of our products. The team is user-first and ensures appropriate external communications from Stripe and senior management to keep our users informed of disruption to their experience of Stripe. The team is skilled in communications, incident handling and technical adeptness as incidents can arise from anywhere and cut across products and orgs in Stripe.

What you’ll do

As an Incident Response Manager (IRM), you’ll play the key role in driving the right level of response from Stripes to incidents, determining impact, rallying Stripes to mitigate, communicating to users and ensuring appropriate remediations and orchestrate the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process. You’ll work hand-in-hand with IRMs and engineers globally to ensure solid 24/7 coverage on how we monitor, detect, respond, communicate and mitigate incidents. description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.
